svg.title: Octagonal flute in D, sheet 1 of 1
svg.desc: 1 user unit = 1mm. Six-hole transverse flute in D, octagonal bore, sheet 1 of 1: cork disc, lip plate, top wall, wall 1, wall 2, wall 3, wall 4, wall 5, wall 6, wall 7. 3mm ply, drawn for a 0.13mm kerf. Blue #0000ff engraves two lines on the top wall, which lies outside face up: where the cork's face goes, and where the model puts the foot, to trim toward. Then orange #ff8000 cuts the embouchure and the holes, and black #000000 frees the parts.
